editorial.exam_day_guidance: Check with Microsoft for scheduling details through Pearson Vue or Certiport. Register using a personal account rather than an organizational account to ensure your records are preserved properly on exam day.

faq.answer_text: A passing score of 700 or greater is strictly required to pass the exam on a scale ranging from 1 to 1000 for all candidates.
The exam price is based on the specific country or region in which the examination is proctored according to official guidelines established by Microsoft for all registered candidates.
faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?

faq.answer_text: This certification exam is officially offered and administered by Microsoft for individuals starting out in their professional artificial intelligence development career path today across global markets.
You can easily take a free practice assessment by navigating directly to the AI Skills Navigator certification page while signed into your Microsoft account to prepare properly.

editorial.overview: The Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals certification exam covers artificial intelligence concepts, capabilities, and the implementation of AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry. Certified by Microsoft, this examination tests your fundamental understanding of fairness, reliability, safety, privacy, security, and prompt engineering principles across modern cloud workloads, requiring a passing score of 700 on a scale ranging from 1 to 1000.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official study guide and practice assessments on AI Skills Navigator carefully. Gain extensive hands-on experience using the Foundry portal to deploy models, interact with prompts, and build lightweight chat client applications by utilizing the Foundry SDK successfully during your preparation process for the 700 score.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is suited for individuals at the beginning of their career in AI solution development. Candidates need conceptual knowledge of AI solutions in Azure, along with familiarity with Python coding syntax, programming techniques, and Azure resources.

exam_price_notes: Price based on the country or region in which the exam is proctored (Microsoft does not publish a USD list price).
